name: Roads at Risk - Ocean City DEM
source: USGS 3DEP Bare Earth DEM Dynamic ImageServer
sourceDescription: USGS 3D Elevation Program (3DEP) Bare Earth DEM Dynamic service, retrieved for the Roads at Risk municipal rollout.
processing: Exported from USGS 3DEP at municipal extent, masked to the Ocean City boundary, adaptively resampled to 11.3 ft pixels to keep the browser-delivered raster within operational size limits, and compressed as a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF.
